reviews.text:
Through our beloved Gangnam Central Baptist Church, I, who was unable to rise up in despair amid numerous failures and giving up, was able to stand up again by learning the love that never gives up on Jesus. I also learned the hope that will never disappear and am rising again and again with that hope, becoming a witness of Christ🙏 Come to Gangnam Central Baptist Church, the body of the Lord, a church full of love, truth, joy and hope~~

Our Gangnam Central Baptist Church was originally located in the Nonhyeon temple near Gangnam-gu Office Station for about 50 years, but is currently building a new temple. We are currently worshiping with joy and gratitude in a great temporary temple called Gangnam Central Vision Center, located on the 5th floor of Wangsimni Bitplex Mall, next to Twosome Place, and opposite the CGV movie theater. We are moving toward Jesus, the signpost, with the vision of W.O.R.L.D♡

The Youth Ministry, under the name of Gangcheong (Gangnam Central Baptist Church Youth Ministry), prays and worships fervently at the Wednesday Ignite meeting every Wednesday at 7:30 PM in order to deeply encounter the Creator God in the youth and establish a holy culture that is distinct from the world. Under the name of HOLY WIN and MCC (Mission Campus & Comapany), we go on praise busking and open-air evangelism to Konkuk University and Wangsimni every month to spread the gospel in the field, living faith and powerful prayer. I have something to learn. We welcome everyone in the name of Jesus♡♡
